youtube_description:
If you have belly fat, stop doing crunches. The one ab exercise that works on your waist is the standing stomach vacuum, and it takes 20 seconds. Here is exactly how I do it.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro02-the-vacuum

Ab exercises build the muscle on the front of your stomach, not burn the fat on it, so while you still have belly fat they can make your stomach stick out more. The stomach vacuum trains the transverse abdominis, the hidden sleeve of muscle under your six-pack, and it forces you to look at the problem every day.

How to do the standing vacuum:
1. Do it in a mirror.
2. Do it shirtless.
3. Do it on an empty stomach.
4. Slump, then suck your stomach in as hard as you can.
5. Hold for 20 seconds with a timer.
6. Keep taking short breaths through your nose.
Start with one 20 second set each morning, then build to three sets with a minute of rest between them.

I also started Zepbound at the same time I started doing vacuums, so I can't say how much of my waist change was the vacuum. Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before you start any medication.
